messages:
maria: FYI — Night maintenance window tonight 23:00-01:00 UTC for az27. Plan: staged node cordons, KV-cache preheat, and a brief BGP quiet window for upstream route stability. Expected customer impact: <5-10% cold-cache for some requests during backfill.

maria: Cohorts: 3 racks per cohort, 10m gap between cohorts. We'll start with cohort A at 23:00 UTC.

maria: Runbook highlights:
- cordon + drain non-critical pods, keep latency-sensitive tasks on warm pools.
- run kvseed preheat (see command below).
- BGP quiet window: announce-only withdraw suppression for 2m per swap.

maria: KV preheat command (example):
```
# run on controlplane
./tools/kvseed --region=az27 --cohort=A --parallel=4 --ttl=3600
kubectl cordon gpu-node-az27-01 && kubectl drain gpu-node-az27-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=60
```

devin: Will Dedicated customers in az27 see throttling or instance restarts?

maria: @devin no forced restarts. Dedicated pools are reserved; we will avoid draining dedicated host-affinity nodes unless absolutely required. Some tenants on shared pools might experience short queueing as KV fills.

liam: Cost question — if we need to backfill with on-demand GPUs for canary, what's the runway?

maria: Estimate: worst-case on-demand burst for 2 cohorts ~= $1.5k-$2.5k. We have contingency credits from finance; I asked for sign-off earlier today.

saniya: Suggest adding a canary cohort (1 rack) in eu-central before we touch az27 so we can validate warm cache pressure and KV hit-rate. Also raise HPA min pods by 1 during window to avoid oscillation.

maria: Good call @saniya. We'll insert eu-central canary at 22:30 UTC and bump HPA. I'll update the ops-playbook.

devin: Any changes to routing fallback if BGP flaps during the quiet window?

maria: Routing: smart-routing will temporarily prefer us-east and eu-central for new sessions if az27 announces are unstable. We have fallbacks configured already. If we detect >3% error rate for 5m, we abort preheat and roll back announcements.

ops-bot: [scheduled] Maintenance ticket INF-2026-187 created. Window: 2026-03-23T23:00:00Z — 2026-03-24T01:00:00Z. Pager rotations: on-call infra/eng-sre.

liam: I'll monitor cost meters and tag any burst spend with "kv-preheat-az27" so finance can reconcile.

saniya: I'll own the canary validation: kv hit-rate, p90 latency, and GPU util smoothing. Will post a quick checklist in the ticket before 22:00 UTC.

maria: Thanks all — final checklist:
- 22:00 UTC: ops-playbook updated + HPA bump in manifest repo
- 22:30 UTC: eu-central canary preheat (validate)
- 23:00 UTC: cohort A az27 begin cordon + kvseed
- 23:10-00:50 UTC: cohorts B,C staggered with 10m gaps
- rollback if p90 latency > 200ms or error rate > 3% for 5m

maria: ping @oncall if you see abnormal tail latency during the window. :eyes: Good luck, night crew.
